verdict.rationale: Brex documents many REST APIs (Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Payments, and others), a quickstart, Postman, Pipedream and Zapier guides, and an MCP server. None of the evidence mentions official SDKs or client libraries. Raw APIs, low-code integrations and an MCP server are adjacent features, not SDKs, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
